searchText: Hi all, has devnet 5 been stopped? It seems that the block number always be 0x29125. And what is the schedule of devnet 6? We could not find a working devnet now... Yes devnet 5 stopped, see dencun interop channel <@552133098075193354> maybe we can get rid of this channel and only have the dencun testing channel? Seems there's another quirk in the 4844 type spec The transaction is defined as `rlp([chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_data_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s])` i.e. a few new fields, otherwise the old format Then in validation, we go on to explicitly reject the `to` field being `nil`: ``` # destination must be not be empty assert tx.to != None ``` Shouldn't we instead have the `to` filed be mandatory instead of optional like other txs? Then a nil field could never happen, it would be rejected already during parsing from RLP or JSON or whereever So we w2ould remove a whole class of issues by allowing nil in the data struct bot forbidding it in reality Or do we envision enabling it in the future at some point and keeping it optional for that purpose? cc <@415109946682769408> cc <@543900561460822016> I think any future blob tx type will have a different structure, so I would vote for making to mandatory in the rlp Hmmm, interestingly, an EL client *could* just ignore the spec and make it mandatory itself only Then Geth would reject the tx when it arrives at the network / from the engine API as invalid whereas "spec conforming" clients would accept it from the wire, but reject it later during validation The end result would be kind of the same, just a weird quirk Uh but that sounds like it could cause a bunch of issues Better to fail the same check on all clients yes, it could get werid, so my 2c is to fix the spec (I mean I doubt it would, but still) Nethermind plans to decline early on deserialization as for other non nullable fields so this check was _intended_ to convey that you could early reject blob txs with nil `to`, but i realize it isn't so clear so i will make it clearer fyi CL now has no tx validation after we changed it to RLP pr to update: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7100 correct, lodestar now treats it like any other opaque tx leaving the computed versioned hashes to tx versioned hashes matching to EL via new payload How about we do that after devnet-6, the last 4844-only devnet? Not a strong opinion, though: if people want to nuke it now and move to <#892088344438255616>, I'm happy with that too!

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: The transaction is defined as `rlp([chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_data_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s])`

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: i.e. a few new fields, otherwise the old format

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content:
Then in validation, we go on to explicitly reject the `to` field being `nil`:

```
            # destination must be not be empty
            assert tx.to != None
```

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: Shouldn't we instead have the `to` filed be mandatory instead of optional like other txs?

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: Or do we envision enabling it in the future at some point and keeping it optional for that purpose?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: I think any future blob tx type will have a different structure, so I would vote for making to mandatory in the rlp

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: Hmmm, interestingly, an EL client *could* just ignore the spec and make it mandatory itself only

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: Then Geth would reject the tx when it arrives at the network / from the engine API as invalid

excerpts.author: karalabe
